name: smwmusic-pok-mon-nightmare-invasion-silence
title: Pokémon Nightmare: Invasion - Silence
description:
A very light song intended to give your player the heeby jeebies. Can work is some haunted area, forest, overworld, you name it. For Halloween hacks.

I believe the original author, Xargoth, did some mix between Lavender Town and Pokemon Tower; from Pokemon Red/Blue/Yellow.
